definition: Assess whether fixes were completed within an explicitly stated expected duration or target date. Apply a negative score only when the report establishes that a fix took longer than expected. Without both an expectation and an actual duration or completion date, timeliness is unknown.
positive_criteria: Fix duration or completion date is within the stated expectation
negative_criteria: Explicitly reports a fix taking longer than its estimate or target
Provides expected and actual timings that establish an overrun
